svg.title: Project 9: symmetrical trance face
svg.text: Trace the gray design, or paint it in your palette. Mandala and swirls first, then chevrons and dots. Gems last, outside the eye area.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Red dotted ovals: eye area. Only eye-safe liner and mascara there; no neon, glitter or gems.
